title: Work Cost of the Junta Learning Algorithm
statement: For each fixed $k\in\mathbb{N}$ and each learning accuracy $\varepsilon\in[0,1/2]$, the work cost of the low-degree junta learning algorithm, viewed as a function of the input dimension $n$, is $O\!\left((n+1)^{\lfloor 3k/4\rfloor+4}\right)$ as $n\to\infty$.
hypotheses_covered: The asymptotic variable $n$ ranges over the natural numbers
